suggestions: I'm grateful for a staging bug that reared its head before production did, sparing me a very bad weekend.
I'm thankful for my mom still asking kalau dah makan ke belum before anything else on the phone.
I'm grateful for the five minutes before Fajr when the whole street's still asleep and nothing's asking anything of me.
I'm thankful for the senior engineer who walked me through the legacy code instead of just rubber-stamping my PR.
I'm grateful for ducking under a roof the exact second the rain started, not two minutes too late.
I'm thankful for a payslip that clears a full week before the credit card statement does, for once.
I'm grateful for that one missing comma that took three hours to find and made the whole stack trace click.
I'm thankful for my dad's one-line WhatsApp texts that somehow still carry the whole weight of him checking in.
I'm grateful for the office aircon actually working today, no sweating through the morning standup.
I'm thankful for a lead who told me to log off at six and clearly meant it, not just said it for show.
I'm grateful for the roti canai stall that's always still open whenever I finally shut the laptop.
I'm thankful for a Grab driver who let the whole ride pass in silence instead of small talk I didn't have energy for.
I'm grateful for a teammate who quietly covered my standup update without ever bringing it up again.
I'm thankful for my grandmother's old duit raya advice still making more sense than most of my own budgeting.
I'm grateful for a group chat that's been running the same dumb joke for six years and it still lands every time.
